record.prompt:
Return exactly one JSON object with the sole top-level key resources, whose value is an array of Kubernetes resource objects. No Markdown fences, comments, explanations, duplicate keys, or additional resources. Use Kubernetes 1.34 API schemas. This is a static configuration task; do not execute commands or contact a cluster.

Create exactly a Deployment api (apps/v1) and Service api (v1) in namespace bench. Deployment: replicas 3, selector/pod labels app=api, one container app with image nginx:1.28.0 and a single named http port 8080. Service: explicit type ClusterIP, selector app=api, and one TCP port named http at port 80 targeting the named http port. Other workload configuration is optional. Selectors must include app=api in matchLabels (or the Service selector map) and match the Deployment pod labels. Additional pod labels and selector constraints are allowed when they still match those pods. Both container and Service ports must use TCP; omitting protocol uses the TCP default.

errors: expected an object containing only 1–16 resources
